verdict.rationale: Qapita is an equity-management SaaS that markets automated reporting and fund administration, so asking whether users can version, review, and roll back automations is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence pack documents user-defined automations, version history, review workflows, or rollback. The mentions of "automated" reporting describe product features, not user-managed automation lifecycle controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
